corrected_content.problem: Consider the vector field $\mathbf{F}=x\operatorname{cos}yz\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{i}+y\operatorname{ln}xz\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{k}$. Evaluate $\mathrm{∇}\times \mathbf{F}$ at the point $(1, \frac{π}{2}, 1)$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
The source asks for curl. For $\mathbf F=\langle x\cos(yz),0,y\ln(xz)\rangle$, where $xz>0$,
$$\nabla\times\mathbf F=\left\langle\ln(xz),-xy\sin(yz)-\frac yx,xz\sin(yz)\right\rangle.$$
At $(1,\pi/2,1)$ this becomes $\langle0,-\pi,1\rangle$.
